text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Proposal (RFP) for the Design and Construction Contract Administration for the African Savanna Indoor Viewing and Holding Project.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the award of RFP-23 for the Design and Construction Contract Administration of the African Savanna Indoor Viewing and Holding Project to Stantec Architecture Ltd. in the amount of $3,439,913 (including disbursements), excluding applicable taxes.
